data.cultural_impact: The name Mahish is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and symbolizes power, strength, and fearlessness. This story also highlights the importance of courage, determination, loyalty, and unwavering faith.

It serves as a reminder that no matter the size or strength of the challenge, one can overcome it with the power of self-belief, resilience, and loyalty to the divine.
